title: A “support bot” asks for your recovery words
scenario: A support bot in a gaming marketplace says your wallet connection failed and asks you to enter the 12 recovery words so it can “resync ownership.”

answers.A: Never enter recovery words into support chat or a website; close it and use the wallet provider’s official recovery guidance.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or knowledgeable person to help verify the wallet issue without sharing the recovery phrase.
answers.C: Enter the words only if the page is inside the marketplace you already use.

explanation: Recovery phrases are master keys to the wallet. No legitimate support process needs them to verify ownership.
proTip: Recovery words are the wallet, not a support ticket.
